title_en: Call centers with image or video based priority
abstract_en: Disclosed are apparatus and methods for utilizing the camera or video capability of particular communication devices, such as cell phones, to enhance handling of calls, such as emergency calls. In one implementation, when a call is made to an emergency response center (ERC) using an image/video capable communication device is queued until an agent is available for handling the call, one or more images or video may be collected from such caller by utilizing the image/video capability of the caller's communication device. The images collected from a plurality of different callers may then be sorted into different event groups. For instance, all the images/video that relate to a same emergency event, such as a traffic accident, are grouped together into a same event group. The different groups can then be prioritized for handling by an available agent. Additionally, the individual callers for each group may also be prioritized based on the collected images/video, e.g., the caller that is closest to the emergency event may be called first.
assignees: CISCO TECH INC;JAIN MUKUL;KUMAR SANJEEV;PATEL LABHESH;SHAFFER SHMUEL

title_en: System and method for geospatial event occurrence prediction
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system for predicting geospatial event generation and a method thereof are provided to perform logistic regression analysis, artificial neural network analysis, and decision determination tree analysis based on information related to the geospatial event generation, thereby accurately predicting and analyzing the geospatial event generation. CONSTITUTION: Geographic information system (GIS) based databases (100,200) provide a factor and geospatial event data which influence a possibility of geospatial event generation of an analysis object area. A correlation analysis unit (300) analyzes correlation of a geospatial event by using a statistics technique and a data mining technique based on the databases. A prediction diagram making unit (400) makes geospatial event generation prediction diagrams based on analysis information. A prediction diagram verification unit (500) verifies accuracy for the geospatial event generation prediction diagrams. A result deriving unit derives an accurate result diagram by comparing the verified geospatial event generation prediction diagrams. [Reference numerals] (100) Underground water space database; (200) Mudflat sedimentation environment database; (300) Geospatial event correlation analysis unit; (400) Geospatial event generation prediction diagram making unit; (500) Geospatial event generation prediction diagram verification unit; (600) Result comparison deriving unit
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지리정보시스템 및 통계, 데이터마이닝 기법을 이용한 지공간사건발생가능 예측시스템 및 이를 이용한 지공간사건발생가능 예측방법에 관한 것으로, 지하수 분포과 갯벌저서생물 서식지 분포를 예시한다. 특히 특히 분석대상지역의 투수량계수와 비양수량의 정보를 제공하는 대수층 수리특성 데이터베이스와 지형, 지질, 선구조, 지표피복, 지하수관련 요인의 정보를 제공하는 수문지질인자 데이터베이스 구축부, 갯벌 저서생물 분포지역의 퇴적환경정보를 제공하는 갯벌 퇴적환경 데이터베이스와 상기 두 데이터베이스에서 제공되는 정보를 바탕으로 지공간사건발생과 요인들간의 상관관계를 분석하는 지공간사건발생 상관관계 분석부, 상기 상관관계 분석부에서 분석된 정보를 바탕으로 지공간사건발생가능 예측도를 작성하는 예측도작성부; 상기 지공간사건발생가능 예측도를 이용하여 지공간사건발생가능성의 정확도를 검증하는 검증부; 상기 예측 모델에서 분석된 모든 예측도의 비교를 위한 결과 도출부; 를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method of situation awareness technology for smart city oriented cross-city security service platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method of a situation awareness technology for a smart city oriented cross-city security service platform. A situation awareness system of the security service platform of the smart city comprises a security situation analysis database, a security threat active discovery and detection subsystem, a network security incident correlation analysis and early warning subsystem, a network security index calculation subsystem and a network security situation display subsystem. Security threat detection, condition monitoring, security situation awareness, trend prediction and other security services are provided. The security situation awareness system disclosed by the invention supports a nationwide cross-city platform application mode; the worry of a city manager and citizens about information system security is solved, information security is guaranteed, and information leakage is prevented; the potential safety hazard generated by inconsistent information security protection mechanism levels of various systems is reduced; The fund contradiction of security guarantee system construction is relieved, and the reconstruction and the resource waste caused by the fact that each city establishes an own information security guarantee system are avoided.
assignees: DIGITAL CHINA INFORMATION SYSTEMS CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for fast channel deployment at an incident scene
abstract_en: Fast channel deployment is achieved amongst subscriber devices (SDs) having an incident scene role at an incident scene. An SD detects an incident scene arrival trigger associated with arrival at an incident scene. Responsive to detecting the incident scene arrival trigger, the SD (i) tunes to a pre-configured incident channel or (ii) scans a plurality of channels for an incident channel and tunes to the incident channel once located. The SD receives, via the incident channel, an incident scene role to traffic channel mapping that maps a particular incident scene role associated with the subscriber device to a particular assigned traffic channel on which subscriber devices associated with a same incident scene role may communicate. The SD tunes to the particular assigned traffic channel as a function of the incident scene role to traffic channel mapping.

title_en: Backup, Archive and Disaster Recovery Solution with Distributed Storage over Multiple Clouds
abstract_en: This invention is a software application utilizing distributed storage systems to provide backup, archive and disaster recovery (BCADR) functionality across multiple clouds. The multi-cloud aware BCADR application and distributed storage systems are utilized together to prevent data lost and to provide high availability in disastrous incidents. Data deduplication reduces the storage required to store many backups. Reference counting is utilized to assist in garbage collection of staled data chunks after removal of staled backups.

title_en: A kind of data management system suitable for big data
abstract_en: The present invention relates to data management systems, more particularly to a kind of data management system suitable for big data, including the big data application end for providing a user big data application access, the service providing module accessed for providing a user cloud computing service being connected with big data application end, what is be connected with service providing module is used to carry out data to dispatch with longitudinal time-divisional stereoscopic parallel, form the data dispatch module of grid operation front end, what is be connected with data dispatch module is used to carry out data the data cloud storage unit of cloud storage, the redundancy determination module for being judged with the presence or absence of redundancy storing data being connected with data cloud storage unit, the deduplication module for being deleted the repeated data in storage being connected with data cloud storage unit；Technical solution provided by the present invention can effectively overcome that data processing speed present in the prior art is relatively slow, data have the defects that security risk, integral data are unable to get and preferably apply.

title_en: Automatic response system for same contents 119 call
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic answering machine connected to a report phone line of a 119 situation room to allow the 119 situation room to response to all situations without delay even if a plurality of situations occur at the same time zone by filtering duplicate reports with the automatic answering machine in order to prevent occurrence of a situation that 119 report phone calls of other accidents can not be received due to occupancy of all report phone lines of the 119 situation room by congestion of 119 report phone calls with the same content when fire and rescue situations occur. According to the present invention, a procedure that a report phone call originated within a predetermined distance around an accident occurrence point is connected to the automatic answering machine to be hung up by being notified that a rescue team is already responded in case of the same content, and a report for requesting a rescue in a corresponding accident field or a report for providing necessary information or a report for other accidents is connected to a worker for a telephone conversation by pressing a guide button to take a measure without delay for all situations by the 119 situation room, is performed. Therefore, when the 119 situation room uses a system of the present invention, a report reception for other accidents occurring in the same time zone can be performed without delay by preventing occupancy of report phone lines of the 119 situation room by having several reports with the same content at the same time when fire and rescue situations occur.

title_en: Device, system and method for duplicate call handling at a public-safety answering point device
abstract_en: A device, system and method for duplicate call handling at a public-safety answering point (PSAP) device is provided. The PSAP device: routes a call from a caller to a call-taker, the call associated with an incident; receives, via an input device of the call-taker, information related to the incident to populate a record associated with the call; prior to the record being complete, receives, via the input device, input to handover the call to an information collection application, the input indicative of the call being a duplicate call; determines, via the information collection application, remaining information to be collected based on one or more of: a duplicate call policy and the information already received; receives, via the information collection application to verbally communicating with the caller on the call, at least a portion of the remaining information to continue to populate the record; and ends the call.

title_en: Apparatus and method for emergency dispatch
abstract_en: A disclosed method includes receiving data inputs for a plurality of events including alarms, sensors, and mobile device emergency call and emergency alert related emergency data; determining event correlations based on the data inputs to generate a set of correlated events; determining emergency network dispatch rules for each correlated event based on event type; applying corresponding emergency network dispatch rules to each corresponding correlated event; and sending a dispatch recommendation to an emergency network entity for each correlated event based on application of the corresponding emergency network dispatch rules.

title_en: System and method for active shooter detection and evacuation guidance
abstract_en: A system and method for finding the proximate location of an indoor active shooter including: a plurality of acoustic sensors for receiving acoustic information from a monitored area, the sensors being dispersed in the monitored area, and each sensor having a processor for discriminating gunshot candidates from other sounds; and a host processor/server for receiving the gunshot candidates from the sensor and provide further processing to determine if the gunshot candidate is a gunshot. The server may use the first sensor to report as the proximate location of the shooter. As nearby sensors report the same incident, the server may refine the proximate location to within a few feet of the actual location of the shooter. The host processor includes a program or instructions to determine exit routes from the detected shooter and to activate a warning system which directs people away. The warning system includes a plurality of signaling lights capable of producing light in a plurality of selectable colors such that the host processor commands the lights to signal colors which warn people of the direction of the proximate location and other colors which direct people away from the proximate location.

title_en: Data storage system and global deduplication method thereof
abstract_en: A data storage system and a global deduplication method thereof are provided. The data storage system includes multiple storage devices and one dispatch device. The dispatch device divides an original data corresponding to a data writing request into at least one data chunk. The dispatch device performs a summary calculation on one data chunk, so as to generate a representative value. The dispatch device performs a first distribution calculation on the representative value, so as to determine a destination location corresponding to the representative value. The dispatch device transmits the data chunk and the representative value to at least one destination storage device among the storage devices through a communication network according to the destination location. The at least one destination storage device checks the representative value, so as to determine whether to store the data chunk in a storage space of the at least one destination storage device.

title_en: Method and device for detecting highway traffic incident
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for detecting a highway traffic incident, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the traffic incident, wherein the traffic incident comprises an alarm position, an alarm time and an incident type, determining whether the same incident as the traffic incident exists at the alarm time or not according to the alarm position, the incident type, internet road condition data, internal equipment positioning data and internal system data, and if so, not giving an alarm to the traffic incident. The traffic incident is analyzed by combining the Internet road condition data, the internal equipment positioning data and the internal system data, the quality of the automatic detection result of the incident detector can be improved, the detection result of the incident detector is screened and filtered, the situation that the same incident alarms repeatedly for many times is avoided, meanwhile, part of alarms which do not need to be processed can be removed, the workload of monitoring personnel is reduced, and the usability of the detection result is improved.

title_en: Event correlation based on pattern recognition and machine learning
abstract_en: A method and a system of improving correlation of events and alerts in or more enterprise networks (103) are disclosed. The method includes receiving, by a processor (402), event data from a plurality of devices (104) in the network (103), wherein the event data comprises one or more of performance metrics data, alerts data, and incident data. The event data is cleaned based on predetermined input parameters and the cleaned event data is labeled based on predetermined definitions. The method further includes performing sequence pattern identification to identify patterns in the labeled event data. The recurring identified patterns are clustered to obtain correlated events. The method includes improving the accuracy of the correlated events using reinforcement learning.

title_en: Traffic incident correlation analysis method and system
abstract_en: A traffic incident correlation analysis method comprises the following specific steps: extracting M1 traffic first features and M2 traffic second features of N spaces in T periods from traffic historical data; wherein the first traffic characteristics are characteristic traffic with time-interval non-variability related to the traffic events, the second characteristics are characteristics with time-interval variability related to the traffic events, and the M1 first traffic characteristics and the M2 second traffic characteristics correspond in time-interval and space; s traffic characteristic similar graphs in T time intervals are constructed, wherein the traffic characteristic similar graphs comprise spaces, an adjacent matrix and traffic second characteristics, and the adjacent matrix is the similarity of traffic first characteristics of the two spaces; extracting M3 third traffic features in N spaces in T time intervals by using a graph learning algorithm based on S traffic feature similar graphs in T time intervals; based on the T periods N spatial M3 third traffic features, N spatial third traffic feature correlations are calculated.

title_en: Method for identifying information in fields within a document that are anomalies
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for notifying authors of a statistical anomaly in paperwork is described herein. During operation information within fields of the paperwork will be identified that statistically differ from information contained in other paperwork from the same incident and/or other paperwork from similar incidents.

title_en: Natural language-based collaborative emergency response SOAR script recommendation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative emergency response SOAR script recommendation method based on natural language, which comprises the following steps: extracting three attributes of people, relation and content from one sentence in the chat content of the battle room, and carrying out data standardization processing; using a text pre-training model BERT as a text encoder to pay differential attention to text contents in a specific use scene and mapping the text contents into word vectors; constructing a standard script library, and performing mask training on the model by adopting a script step prediction algorithm to ensure that the model digs out potential internal relations of each workflow step in the script; event correlation degree feature matching is carried out by using a collaborative filtering algorithm, collaborative work of another dimension is realized, and an SOAR script scheme is recommended; the scheme has the characteristics of spoken language of chat contents, fragmented information and the like aiming at the battle room, and has the characteristics of rapidly and accurately transferring SOAR script and timely coping with security incidents.
assignees: NANJING CROWDWISHI AND WEI INFORMATION SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Amplitude directivity compensation method, device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an amplitude directivity compensation method, an amplitude directivity compensation device, electronic equipment and a medium. The compensating method comprises the steps of obtaining an amplitude directivity compensating factor, and multiplying the compensating factor by a physical simulation data body of the well earthquake according to the same incident angle to obtain a compensated data body. The invention has a certain effect on amplitude compensation of physical simulation data of the well earthquake. The method of the invention is used for carrying out amplitude compensation on the acquired data, the energy after compensation is well recovered, and the subsequent processing and interpretation of the data are improved to a certain extent.

title_en: Method for removing duplicate and automatically dispatching urban events
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for removing weights and automatically dispatching urban events, which belongs to the field of urban government affairs service, and is characterized in that urban events discovered by Internet of things perception, video perception, manual filling, network crawlers and the like are converged to an Internet of things platform, and the Internet of things platform is automatically dispatched to corresponding disposal units for corresponding treatment after the weights and the weights of the events are removed. The event deduplication is to judge the event repetition degree according to the occurrence time and place of the event and the similarity of the natural language processing judgment semantics, merge a plurality of events according to the repetition degree, and push the events into an automatic dispatch queue. The automatic event dispatching is to set a accountability base in advance and to automatically dispatch the event according to the accountability base. The invention can reduce the work of event handlers, improve the working efficiency, avoid the repeated processing of the same event and reduce the workload of manual order dispatching.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR NEW INFRASTRUCTURE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Light pole alarm deduplication analysis method and system based on Bian Yun cooperative computing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lamp post alarm deduplication analysis method and system based on Bian Yun cooperative calculation; wherein the method comprises: the edge gateway obtains an analysis request sent by the control center server, and if the analysis request is continuous frame operation analysis, the collected video is sent to the cloud server; if the discontinuous frame operation analysis is performed, the collected video is processed in the edge gateway; the edge gateway is arranged inside the street lamp pole; after receiving the video, the cloud server and the edge gateway firstly judge whether the required computing resources exceed a set threshold value, if not, the video is subjected to structural analysis, and the cloud server feeds the analysis result back to the edge gateway; and the edge gateway judges repeated data according to the structural analysis result, sends alarm information to the control center server according to the judgment result, and links related equipment.

title_en: Emergent command scheduling system of emergent public health event based on thing networking
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of public health event processing, and discloses an emergency command scheduling system of an emergency public health event based on the Internet of things, which comprises an acquisition unit, a judgment unit, a command unit, a tracking unit, a coordination unit, a notification unit and a cloud unit, wherein the acquisition unit acquires data of an incident place and data in a hospital, performs deduplication on the acquired data and then sends the acquired data to the judgment unit, and the judgment unit receives the data of the acquisition unit and judges the grade of the public health event and then sends the grade to the command unit; after the data acquisition is carried out by the acquisition unit, useless data can be deleted after the data acquisition is carried out, so that the judging speed of the judging unit is improved, further, the command personnel is given enough time to coordinate all aspects, and the problem that the judging unit and the command unit receive a large amount of data to bring about work burden when all the data are adopted and transmitted is avoided.

title_en: Duplicate incident detection using dynamic similarity threshold
abstract_en: Methods, apparatus, and processor-readable storage media for duplicate incident detection using a dynamic similarity threshold are provided herein. An example computer-implemented method includes obtaining a request including information associated with tracking at least a first incident in a database; generating a first representation of the first incident that encodes at least a portion of the information; computing a set of similarity scores for the first incident, where a given similarity score is based on a comparison between the first representation and a second representation generated for one of a plurality of additional incidents in the database; detecting that the first incident is a duplicate of at least one of the plurality of additional incidents based on a comparison of the set of similarity scores to a similarity threshold, where the similarity threshold is updated over time; and initiating an update in the database in response to the detecting.

title_en: Similar event deduplication method based on cosine similarity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a similar event deduplication method based on cosine similarity, which relates to the technical field of information, and comprises the steps of adding proprietary information into a word segmentation library, wherein the proprietary information comprises a grid name and a grid member name, preprocessing an event reported by a grid member by combining the word segmentation library to obtain processed text data, calculating the cosine similarity between the processed text data and the text data of each event in an event description library, judging whether the reported event is similar to the existing event in the event description library according to a set similarity threshold, and marking the reported event as a similar event and removing the similar event if the reported event is similar, otherwise adding the text data of the reported event into the event description library.

title_en: Methods and systems for generating alerts and situation reports
abstract_en: A report generator produces reports during an identified event and these reports are transformed into editable reports that can be auto-updated with newly acquired data in any format selected by a user. The reports can be downloaded or shared in an collaboration application in a selected format, such as PDF, or included as or within forms provided in a system for tracking and providing information about an incident. Alert messages and updated reports may be generated and sent to certain recipients based on monitoring selected data sources for data defined alert trigger thresholds, as well as when event category or severity change. Alert checks are run based on a selected refresh cadence in which datasets from assocaited data sources are assessed based on the trigger content and defined area of interest. Duplicate alerts are avoided by comparing data from all previous alert checks for the same event types.

title_en: REDIS STREAM-based distributed alarm processing method for event centers of Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention provides a REDIS STREAM-based distributed alarm processing method for an Internet of things (IoT) event center, which belongs to the field of Internet of things (IoT) data processing, and utilizes REDIS STREAM high-performance streaming consumption capability and combines a distributed rule matching engine and a cross-device data dynamic association mechanism to realize millisecond-level event processing. The method comprises the steps that data are written into REDIS STREAM according to a stream-Model-DeviceId mode by terminal equipment of the Internet of things to form independent data streams, event consumers read the data from the streams and match based on preloaded rules, cross-equipment linkage calculation is supported through a metadata relation table and an SQL template, real-time deduplication and full life cycle management are conducted on alarm events through a dual convergence mechanism based on a database and a cache, repeated alarms are eliminated, and finally a closed-loop alarm system is constructed through multi-channel pushing and pushing state write-back. The system adopts a layered architecture, comprises an event acquisition layer, a rule processing layer, an event management layer, a push service layer and an asynchronous processing layer, has the characteristics of high throughput, strong order and high reliability, and can effectively improve the alarm processing efficiency and accuracy in a large-scale Internet of things scene.
assignees: INSPUR SMART CITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic screening and optimizing method based on multi-source power grid dispatching data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic screening and optimizing method based on multi-source power grid dispatching data, which comprises the steps of carrying out characteristic extraction on the power grid dispatching data, carrying out unified formatting and compression on data among different data sources, adopting a partial deduplication strategy to deduplicate the data of each data source, and realizing the deduplication of the multi-source power grid dispatching data.

title_en: On-Device AI Mediation and Edge Computing-Based Adaptive Precision Positioning Disaster Communication System and Method
title_ko: 온디바이스 ai 중재 및 엣지 컴퓨팅 기반의 적응형 정밀 측위 재난 통신 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 온디바이스 AI 중재와 5G MEC 기반 3계층 아키텍처를 통해 재난 신고와 전파의 정확성·신속성·생존성을 극대화하는 시스템 및 방법이다. 사용자 단말은 적응형 칼만 필터(AKF)로 멀티모달 센서를 융합하여 GPS 음영 지역에서도 정밀 위치를 확보하고, AI 모듈이 허위·중복 신고를 원천 차단한다. 엣지 서버는 ST-DBSCAN 알고리즘을 통해 실시간 재난 클러스터를 형성하며, 중앙 관제 서버는 이동통신사 망 및 민간 플랫폼과 연동된 하이브리드 전파를 수행하고 실시간 도달률 모니터링(ACK)을 통해 미수신자에게 보완 전파를 수행한다. 아울러 통신 인프라 붕괴 시에는 D2D 메쉬 네트워크로 통신을 복원하고, PoA 블록체인을 통해 전 과정의 데이터 무결성을 보장한다.

title_en: Deduplication of multi-channel emergency response request notifications
abstract_en: An emergency management system (EMS) may be used to provide and deduplicate multi-channel emergency response requests for an emergency responder application. EMS may receive, from an emergency communications center (ECC), a first emergency response request over a first channel and a second emergency response request over a second channel. The first or second channel may at least partially include over-the-air UHF or VHF dispatch transmissions that may be recorded as audio data. EMS may compare addresses, types of emergencies (e.g., fire, medical, etc.), and/or requested services (e.g., fire, medical, etc.) to determine if the first and second emergency response requests are the same. If the requests are the same, EMS deduplicates the requests so that an emergency responder application displays/provides a combined request (reducing distractions of first responders). Providing multi-channel emergency response requests may enable validation and error correction of requests provided to and by an emergency responder application.
